title: Give directions using landmarks
prompt: A visitor is coming to your home for the first time. Give them directions from the nearest main road.
target_behavior: Use landmarks rather than street names or distances.
tips: Name what they'll see at each turn.
Tell them how they'll know they've gone too far.

feedback.headline: The target showed up in your answer — nice.

where.quote: Okay, so the short version: I help a team of twelve ship our app every two weeks.

what_worked: You kept it specific and easy to follow.
feedback.one_change: Try it once more and open with your main point.
